lesson: git rm --cached untrack commit + subsequent pull --rebase = rebase start checkout silently adopts ignored on-disk copies as tracked, then the pick replay materializes the tree-deletion onto the worktree. After ANY rm --cached untrack corrective, same-window pull --rebase is FORBIDDEN; if already rebased, ls-tree on-disk audit + git restore --source recovery.
